description: Use this only for a single page address the user gave. It fits requests such as "what SEO problems does https://example.com/pricing have?" or "is the title and description of this page OK?". Pass the page address. For several pages or a whole site call audit_site once instead of this tool many times. Returns the page rules that failed grouped by priority, each with the fix and the documentation link, plus the title, description, headings and other facts that were read. robots.txt is respected. Not for a whole site or a request to find pages: use audit_site, which also runs the rules that compare pages or read the sitemap. Do not use it for private or local addresses, for rankings or traffic, or to read a page's text.

judge.description: Also ask the judgement service what the page is for, how specific it is and whether pages compete for the same searches. Off by default. It is limited per day, and when unavailable the rule results are returned with a note.

url.description: Address of one public web page, for example https://example.com/pricing. A bare domain means https.
